name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=chapter intro metadata, descriptor=get entry accessor). Name accurately reflects body: returns a pointer to data_fd2_chapter_intro_metadata_table[chapter_id-1]. No Ghidra address residue. All 7 callers pass the 1-based current chapter id and consume the result as a chapter-intro metadata entry pointer.
purpose: Chapter-intro metadata table accessor: returns a pointer to the 0x1F-byte metadata entry for a 1-based chapter id.
logic_summary: Computes &data_fd2_chapter_intro_metadata_table + (chapter_id - 1) * 0x1F (base immediate 0x6238D, stride 0x1F). Pure address arithmetic on the stack arg; no branches, no memory reads, no calls. Disassembly: PUSH EBP; MOV EBP,ESP; MOV EAX,[EBP+8]; DEC EAX; MOV EDX,0x1F; MUL EDX; LEA EDX,[0x6238D]; ADD EAX,EDX; POP EBP; RET.

params.name: chapter_id
params.semantics: 1-based chapter index. Callers pass data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id. Used as (chapter_id-1) to index the metadata table (0-based entry).
params.reason: Name matches its actual use as the 1-based chapter index that drives the table offset. No address residue; not a generic param_N.

returns.semantics: Pointer to data_fd2_chapter_intro_metadata_table[chapter_id-1], a 0x1F-byte chapter-intro metadata entry (bCategory, bHotkey_state, bHotkey_scancode, weapons/items/mystery shop id arrays).

notes: Clean table accessor consistent with sibling functions in table.c (fd2_get_char_base_entry/growth/spell_learning/etc). src comment block (table.c lines 68-73) is already concise and correct (formula and 7-caller count verified against disassembly), so kept. Ghidra plate is the verbose superset (entry layout + table span + caller list) and does not contradict the refined understanding, so left untouched. The base address 0x6238D is referenced only by this accessor (single DATA xref); the data symbol there is data_fd2_chapter_intro_metadata_table. No change made to table.c; only this shard is staged.
